selected_evidence.requirement: datauser is limited to 100 MB under /srv/data by the filesystem
selected_evidence.summary: Shows /srv/data mounted as XFS with usrquota, 100M soft and hard limits for datauser, and a 110 MiB write failing with Disk quota exceeded.

selected_evidence.requirement: Configuration and enforcement persist across restart
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, the mount was active with usrquota, accounting and enforcement were ON, limits remained 100M, persistent data retained its checksum, and an oversized write was still rejected.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID ebf808c5-68cd-4bb5-9787-d13d77dbb1c3, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, proved the new boot ID 255ff88e-89fa-4cec-a823-7e652ef9d451, and confirmed recovered filesystem, quota, account, and data health.
